criteria: New rule, explicit outcome branch, or interaction whose timing/priority/exception changes a ruling; reject cosmetic variants and mechanical recombinations.
pass_author: Parent evaluator; independent challenge is separate.

Tests the procedural state indicator, absent from seed question on returning upright next round.

Tests an exception to treating original tied finalists as the only eligible winners: tie-resolution compensation can make an outsider the single highest player at the table.
